import pathlib, textwrap
progdir=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(g) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != 0]
    row_groups=[]; col_groups=[]
    start=0
    for r in sep_rows+[h]:
        if start<r: row_groups.append(list(range(start,r)))
        start=r+1
    start=0
    for c in sep_cols+[w]:
        if start<c: col_groups.append(list(range(start,c)))
        start=c+1
    panels=[]
    for rs in row_groups:
        row=[]
        for cs in col_groups:
            cells=[[g[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
            colors={v for line in cells for v in line if v!=0}
            row.append((rs,cs,cells,next(iter(colors)) if len(colors)==1 else None))
        panels.append(row)
    nr,nc=len(panels),len(panels[0])
    fills=[]
    for i in range(nr-1):
        for j in range(nc-1):
            block=[panels[i][j],panels[i][j+1],panels[i+1][j],panels[i+1][j+1]]
            occupied=[k for k,p in enumerate(block) if p[3] is not None]
            if len(occupied)!=3 or len({block[k][3] for k in occupied})!=1:
                continue
            missing=next(k for k in range(4) if k not in occupied)
            mi,mj=i+(missing//2),j+(missing%2)
            sources=[]
            # Reflect across the panel boundary from an occupied neighbor.
            if missing%2==0 and missing+1 in occupied: # missing left, source right
                sources.append([line[::-1] for line in block[missing+1][2]])
            if missing%2==1 and missing-1 in occupied: # missing right, source left
                sources.append([line[::-1] for line in block[missing-1][2]])
            if missing//2==0 and missing+2 in occupied: # missing top, source below
                sources.append(block[missing+2][2][::-1])
            if missing//2==1 and missing-2 in occupied: # missing bottom, source above
                sources.append(block[missing-2][2][::-1])
            if sources:
                rs,cs,_,_=panels[mi][mj]
                cells=sources[0]
                fills.append((rs,cs,cells))
    for rs,cs,cells in fills:
        for ii,r in enumerate(rs):
            for jj,c in enumerate(cs):
                if g[r][c]==0:
                    g[r][c]=cells[ii][jj]
    return g
'''
path=progdir/'task-7e3bc9b6.py'; path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print(path)
